title: Influence of number and location of implants and data acquisition device on the accuracy of an app-based extraoral photogrammetry and noncalibrated implant scan body system
html: The accuracy of complete arch implant scans is highly dependent on the implant scanning technique used to capture the implant positions. The influence of the number and location of implants and data acquisition device on the performance of the including app-based extraoral photogrammetry (PG) and noncalibrated implant scan body (ISB) systems remains unknown.
